info.title: Altura Coffee Website Events
info.description: Events published by the Altura Coffee Website when customers submit support requests.

altura/coffee/support/request/{customerI.description: Channel where customer support request events are published. The topic is resolved as `altura/website/support/request/v1/submitted/{customer_id}`.

customerId.description: The customer identifier, URL-encoded. Corresponds to the `customer_id` field in the form payload.

subscribe.summary: Sends a support request event when a customer submits the support form.
subscribe.description: Triggered by a POST to `/api/support-request`. The server wraps the form payload in a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope and publishes it to SAP Advanced Event Mesh via HTTP.

SupportRequestCreated.name: altura.coffee.support.request.created.v1
SupportRequestCreated.title: Customer Support Request Created
SupportRequestCreated.summary: A customer has submitted a support request through the Altura Coffee website.

SupportRequestData.description: Form payload submitted by the customer.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer account.

contact_name.description: Full name of the person submitting the request.

contact_email.description: Email address of the contact person.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the customer.

customer_request.description: Free-text description of the support request submitted by the customer.
customer_request.example: We have a La Marzocco Micra in the Plaza Pablo Picasso office in Madrid 28020, which is not extracting coffee as it should. Can you please send a technician to check the machine.

specversion.description: The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses.

type.description: Type of occurrence which has happened. Often used for routing, observability, policy enforcement.

time.description: Timestamp of when the occurrence happened. Must adhere to RFC 3339.

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the data field.
